## 1. Exploratory Data Analysis

### 1.01 Cleaning Data and choosing variables of interest

We first import the data, and tidy it by removing rows and columns that does not fit the modern excel spreadsheet format.
```{r}
surfaceWaterStat <- read_csv('data/prms_summaryDyn_new.csv')

surfaceWaterStat_nonzero <- surfaceWaterStat %>%
    select(where(~ any(. != 0)))

surfaceWaterStat_nonzero$runoff_cfs <- NULL
surfaceWaterStat_nonzero$Date <- NULL


corr_trix_1 <- cor(surfaceWaterStat_nonzero)
corrplot(corr_trix_1, 
         order = 'AOE', 
         col = COL2("PiYG")
         )




```
